AddressCollectionPanel: Groups an address heading, summary and authored address content.
AddressEditor: Edits street, city, region and postal code through labelled inputs.
AddressSummaryBadge: Shows a compact address label or role.
AddressValidationTimeline: Lists recorded address validation events in time order.
ArchiveEvent: Describes an archive event with its recorded timestamp.
ArchivePill: Marks whether a record is archived.
ArchiveSummary: Shows a record's archive status and related details.
ArchivedRowOverlay: Marks an archived collection row while retaining its content.
AuditEvent: Shows one recorded audit event and its time.
AuditSummaryCard: Summarizes audit coverage and recorded results.
AuditTimeline: Lists entries from a record's audit log.
Badge: Displays a short label with a semantic status treatment.
Banner: Presents a prominent message with optional actions and dismissal.
BillingAmountInput: Edits a billing amount in the selected currency.
BillingCardMeta: Shows compact billing amount and interval metadata.
BillingIntervalSelector: Selects the interval for a recurring charge.
BillingSummaryBadge: Displays a formatted billing amount and optional interval.
Button: Triggers an action using a labelled native button.
CancellationEvent: Describes a recorded cancellation and its time.
CancellationForm: Collects a cancellation reason and code.
CancellationSummary: Shows the recorded cancellation terms for an item.
Card: Groups related content within a bordered surface.
CardHeader: Labels a card with a title and supporting text.
ClassificationEditor: Presents category, tags and classification mode controls.
ClassificationPanel: Groups classification details and authored category content.
ColorStatePicker: Edits the color state of a visual encoding.
ColorSwatch: Displays a color sample with its label.
ColorizedBadge: Shows a label using an explicitly supplied color treatment.
Combobox: Picks one value from a list by typing to filter it.
CommunicationDetailPanel: Displays a communication's recipients, channel and content.
CycleProgressCard: Shows billing cycle progress and remaining days.
DatePicker: Selects a date with a labelled native control.
DetailHeader: Names a record with a heading and optional supporting text.
Dialog: Asks for a decision or shows focused content in a window with a title, actions and a close button.
FilterPanel: Groups filter controls and their explanatory content.
FormLabelGroup: Groups a form label with supporting text.
GeoFieldMappingForm: Maps record fields to geographic coordinates and identifiers.
GeoResolutionBadge: Shows the resolution state of a geographic lookup.
GeocodablePreview: Displays a location preview from supplied geographic data.
Grid: Arranges child content in a responsive grid.
InlineLabel: Displays a compact record label within a line of text.
Input: Edits a scalar value with a labelled native input.
LabelCell: Shows a record label in a collection cell.
MembershipAuditTimeline: Lists recorded membership changes over time.
MembershipPanel: Groups membership information and authored content.
MessageEventTimeline: Lists recorded events in a message's lifecycle.
OwnerBadge: Shows a compact owner label or supplied identifier.
OwnershipSummary: Summarizes the recorded owner, role and transfer information.
PaginationBar: Navigates between pages of a collection.
PaymentEventTimeline: Lists recorded payment events and timestamps.
PaymentTimeline: Shows payment status, method and scheduled payment dates.
PreferenceEditor: Presents controls for a preference record.
PreferencePanel: Groups preference details and authored content.
PreferenceTimeline: Lists recorded preference changes over time.
PriceCardMeta: Shows pricing metadata within a card.
PriceSummary: Summarizes an amount, currency and pricing model.
RelativeTimestamp: Displays a timestamp relative to a reference time.
RoleAssignmentForm: Presents controls for assigning a role.
RoleBadgeList: Displays the roles assigned to a record.
SearchInput: Edits a search query for a collection.
SegmentedControl: Chooses one of two to five options shown as joined segments.
Select: Chooses one value from a labelled list of options.
SortIndicator: Shows a collection column's current sort direction.
Stack: Arranges related child content vertically or horizontally.
StateTransitionEvent: Describes a recorded transition between lifecycle states.
StatusBadge: Displays a readable lifecycle status with its semantic tone.
StatusColorLegend: Explains the colors assigned to lifecycle states.
StatusTimeline: Shows the current status and recorded lifecycle events.
Switch: Turns a labelled setting on or off at once.
Table: Displays labelled columns and rows of tabular data.
Tabs: Switches between labelled panels of related content.
TagInput: Edits the tags assigned to a record.
TagManager: Presents a list of tags with tag editing controls.
TagPills: Displays tags as individual compact labels.
TemplatePicker: Selects a template from supplied choices.
Text: Displays text with a chosen semantic HTML element.
TimelineEntryLabel: Labels a timeline entry with a title and supporting text.
VizAreaControls: Edits the settings for an area chart.
VizAreaPreview: Displays an area chart from bound chart data.
VizAxisControls: Edits axis labels, visibility and formatting.
VizGraphPreview: Displays a graph or network chart from bound data.
VizHeatmapControls: Edits the settings for a heatmap.
VizHeatmapPreview: Displays a heatmap from bound chart data.
VizLineControls: Edits the settings for a line chart.
VizLinePreview: Displays a line chart from bound chart data.
VizMarkControls: Edits the mark settings for a chart.
VizMarkPreview: Displays a chart using the bound mark specification.
VizPointControls: Edits the settings for point marks.
VizPointPreview: Displays point marks from bound chart data.
VizRoleBadge: Labels a field's role in a chart.
VizScaleControls: Edits scale settings for a visual encoding.
VizScatterControls: Edits the settings for a scatter plot.
VizScatterPreview: Displays a scatter plot from bound chart data.
VizShapeLegend: Explains the shapes assigned to chart categories.
